name: DividedSplitting.theta_pointForm
summary: Apply theta_pointForm at h·γ, move γ (supported on M and M̄) from the point into the datum by the Weil representation at those places, which multiplies by the Weil scalar and transforms the residue datum into Ψ_L.

steps.claim: By theta_pointForm, the left side is the conjugate of the kernel at (g, h·γ) with the datum of Y; write (g, hγ) = (g, h)·(1, γ), let the finite point γ act on the integrated datum (pairWeil_integrated_fin), and use that γ is supported on the places of M², where the Weil action on the named datum is explicit (pairWeil_name_on, M² prime to its conjugate); its determinant factor is that of detOn.
steps.lean:
erw [_root_.theta_pointForm, ← mul_one g, ← Prod.one_mk_mul_one_mk, modKernel, ← Prod.mk_mul_mk,
    pairTheta_mul,
    pairWeil_integrated_fin, pairWeil_name_on (disjoint_places_star _), (_ : detOn _ _ = _)]

steps.claim: The scalar is the Weil scalar of L; compare the data pointwise in y, rewriting the condition by genResidue_smul_eq_iff.
steps.lean: simp [pairTheta, ← V.genResidue_smul_eq_iff, DividedLattice.weilScalar]; congr with y

steps.claim: Unfold the named datum, reducedInverse and the matrix products entrywise.
steps.lean:
simp [liftFn_apply, vecToMat, ← ext_iff, mul_apply, DividedLattice.reducedInverse, ← map_mul,
    ← map_sum, Matrix.map]

steps.claim: Split on whether the transformed matrix is integral (the dite).
Integral case: the datum is evaluated at the transformed matrix; compare the two sides argument by argument (congr! 8), in three goals:
steps.lean:
· rw [dite_eq_left]; congr! 8
    · ext; simp [matToVec, mul_apply, mul_sum]; ring
    · congrm ⟦⟨_ * ?_, _⟩⟧
      set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 200000 in
      simpa using! congr($(Matrix.map_mul.trans congr($(atPlace_twistPlace_eq_one
        (inv_mem L.mem_supportedOn) _).1 * _)) _ _)
    simp [idem_mul_mem_Ô]; exact fun a b w
      m ↦ by simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, ← mul_sum, matToVec, ← mul_apply, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      m, genIdele_apply_of_notMem fun ⟨i, e⟩ ↦ (disjoint_places_star _).le_bot ⟨m,
      places_levelModulus.ge ⟨inl i, e⟩⟩] using mem_Ô.1 (sum_mem (t := univ) fun c _ ↦
      mul_mem (star_mem_Ô (U.inv_val_eq_conjTranspose L.γ ▸ L.integral c a :)) (h c b)) w

steps.claim: the transformed matrix is the product with ϖγ⁻¹ (entrywise sums);
At the twist places the component of γ⁻¹ is 1 (atPlace_twistPlace_eq_one, γ⁻¹ supported on the chosen places), so the twist-place residues are unchanged;
steps.lean:
· congrm ⟦⟨_ * ?_, _⟩⟧
      set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 200000 in
      simpa using! congr($(Matrix.map_mul.trans congr($(atPlace_twistPlace_eq_one
        (inv_mem L.mem_supportedOn) _).1 * _)) _ _)

steps.claim: The transformed matrix is integral at every place: away from M the generator is 1 (genIdele_apply_of_notMem, M disjoint from its conjugate), and its entries are sums of products of conjugates of the integral entries of ϖγ⁻¹ (L.integral, γ = (γ⁻¹)ᴴ) with integral entries.
steps.lean:
simp [idem_mul_mem_Ô]; exact fun a b w
      m ↦ by simpa [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, ← mul_sum, matToVec, ← mul_apply, ← Matrix.mul_assoc,
      m, genIdele_apply_of_notMem fun ⟨i, e⟩ ↦ (disjoint_places_star _).le_bot ⟨m,
      places_levelModulus.ge ⟨inl i, e⟩⟩] using mem_Ô.1 (sum_mem (t := univ) fun c _ ↦
      mul_mem (star_mem_Ô (U.inv_val_eq_conjTranspose L.γ ▸ L.integral c a :)) (h c b)) w

steps.claim: Non-integral case: if the condition G·S̄ = ϖ̄·I_incl held, the matrix would be integral, a contradiction; so both sides vanish (absurd, peel).
steps.lean: split_ifs with _ H; absurd h; peel H

steps.claim: That implication: multiply the condition by ϖ̄ and use reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff entrywise.
steps.lean:
simpa [matToVec, mul_assoc, mul_apply, mul_sum, mul_left_comm, inclMatrix, sq,
    reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff.2, ← map_mul,
    reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff, ← map_sum] using congr(V.genResidue * $this)

steps.claim: Remaining membership goals: γ is supported on the chosen places, so its twist-place components are 1 (aesop).
steps.lean:
all_goals have := L.mem_supportedOn; aesop (add simp [places_levelModulus,
    atPlace_twistPlace_eq_one, Set.Sum.elim_range])
